title: SugarCraft — SugarMcp
description: SugarMcp: MCP client core — JSON-RPC 2.0 codec, stdio transport with bounded child lifecycle, initialize/tools handshake, deny-before-allow tool narrowing. Extracted from sugar-crush; first-party.
ogDescription: One faithful Model Context Protocol client core for the whole ecosystem: a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope codec, a newline-framed stdio transport with a bounded, orphan-proof child lifecycle, the initialize/tools handshake, and deny-before-allow tool narrowing.
tagline: MCP client core — JSON-RPC codec, stdio transport, tool narrowing
